paragraphs.text: The Unluckiest is an unnamed planeswalker from an undefined plane , who is cursed with bad luck.
The bearded planeswalker is snazzy and sharp, but always in the wrong place at the wrong time. He has a knack of getting in trouble, yet always ends up not dying.

At some point, this planeswalker ran afoul of the Innistradi warlock Lynde , who is the source of his curses. She keeps a doll in his image, which she uses for dark magic. She describes him as the single most annoying person she has ever met in her exceptionally long life.

It has been speculated that, with his luck, the Unluckiest Planeswalker certainly would have ended up on Ravnica during the War of the Spark , although this has not been confirmed. At some point, he ended up on Duskmourn .

The Unluckiest Planeswalker was first depicted in a cycle of Curses featured in Commander 2017 , each depicting a different plane. He was later also depicted on Flame Blitz in Modern Horizons 2 . When he received a planeswalker card in Mystery Booster Commander Edition , he was kept both nameless and subtypeless.
The Unluckiest has an uncanny resemblance to Kieran Yanner , the artist who created the art for the first cycle of cards.
